- Open question (tier floors measured on the record view, so a 1440 px screen with the sidebar open lands on two columns): PM discretion A — keep 1280 / 1024; at 1184 px three columns are cramped and the two-column tier already pairs details with the timeline. The maintainer has the preview and can override; B is a one-constant follow-up card if asked.
